chains.trait: Three paddle-limbs & one spindly tool arm
links: Extreme limb reduction for weight distribution
36g surface acceleration demanding low center of mass
Qu metric manipulation creating super-dense crust

skill.effect: It scrambles up steep inclines without ever losing its footing. You can secure extra supplies onto its back for the journey.

chains.weakness: Vulnerable to sudden weight loss or low-gravity zones
observe: Broad, splayed limb pads pressing flat
One arm extended holding crude tools
Body resting heavily on the substrate

plausibility.summary: State openly that 36 g (F4) is non-natural and requires Qu skeletal/muscle redesign (neotenous low-profile body, pad-like limbs, no Earth-primate limb loads); game crawl skill is substrate-pressing, not upright walking.

skill.effect: The creature constantly tilts its face upward, keeping a sharp watch on the sky. This keen awareness lets it easily spot any threat drawing near from overhead.

chains.weakness: Cannot track fast-moving prey at ground level without turning
observe: One eye staring straight up at the sky
Jaw hinging vertically to crush stone
Asymmetric ear pits tilted toward vibration

journal.en: A face carved by crushing weight, looking up for mercy.

relations.note: Asymmetric People are engineered by Lopsiders for lower gravity, then reverse-engineer the process to exterminate their creators.
Striders evolve extreme verticality and fragile cartilage for 0.2g; Lopsiders evolve wide stances and paddle-limbs for 36g.
